source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-10 by exhaustive search with no input array and no random numbers. Rows are permuted by one cycle of length 9, three cycles of length 3 and one fixed row. The program programs/orbq6.c lists every ternary column whose 9 images under that row permutation are pairwise qualitatively independent (423,360 column orbits), joins two orbits when all their columns are pairwise qualitatively independent, and lists every set of 5 mutually joined orbits up to the normaliser of the row permutation (7936 sets, each a 19 x 45 covering array). For each set it lists every further column that is qualitatively independent of all 45 columns and finds the largest mutually independent set of them. 48 of the sets take 4 further columns and none takes 5. The array is the first such set with its 4 columns (command NOORDER=1 orbq6 s19a.txt 5 4 out, about 5 minutes on one core). Exact check with ca_verify, all column pairs
construction: Array invariant under a row permutation with cycles 9, 3, 3, 3, 1: five column orbits of length 9 and four further columns, found by exhaustive search
notes: ties the cited size 19 at k = 49; no Torres-Jimenez array is an ingredient or start; no input array; the search program was written by an AI model for this project
